findings.title: Waterings list crashes on a malformed response and keeps showing the old, unfiltered rows under 'Loading waterings…'
findings.expected: A visible load error and no rows from another bed
findings.actual: Uncaught 'waterings.value?.reduce is not a function'. The page stays on 'Loading waterings…' with all beds' rows still listed under the 'Shade corner' filter
findings.evidence: ["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"] | ["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"]

findings.title: Opening Waterings when the list answer is not an array crashes the navigation and leaves the user on the previous page
findings.expected: The Waterings page opens and shows a load error
findings.actual: Uncaught 'waterings.value?.reduce is not a function'. The Beds page stays on screen while the URL says /waterings

findings.title: Changing the bed filter while the request hangs leaves 'Loading waterings…' forever, with the previous unfiltered rows still shown
findings.expected: The old rows are cleared or marked stale, and the request times out with an error
findings.actual: After 13 s it still shows 'Loading waterings…' and lists North bed rows (with working Delete buttons) under the 'Shade corner' filter
